# Vendored webfont licenses

The four families under this directory were fetched from Weebly's CDN
(`cdn2.editmysite.com/fonts/...`) on 2026-09-02. Each is an open-source
project under its own upstream license (Weebly's CDN only rehosts them).

| Family | Upstream project | License |
|---|---|---|
| Amaranth | Amaranth by Gesine Todt (Cyreal releases) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL) |
| Montserrat | Montserrat by Julieta Ulanovsky (The Montserrat Project) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL) |
| Open Sans | Open Sans by Steve Matteson (commissioned by Google) | Apache License 2.0 (original release); relicensed OFL 1.1 upstream |
| Gentium Basic | Gentium Basic / Gentium by SIL International | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL) |

The OFL and Apache 2.0 both permit redistribution and web embedding. Only the
non-font vendored CSS in the parent directory (`sites.css`, `main_style.css`,
`fh-kit.css`) is of proprietary origin — see `../PROVENANCE.txt`.
